Mooby'sDogmaAngels, a muse and a fast food cow.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersWisconsin cheese curdsCheese curds in a crisp lager batter, fried and served with dipping sauceHow to make it150g plain flour1 egg200ml lager1 pinch salt400g cheese curds2 L vegetable oil, for frying150ml ranch dressingWhisk the flour, egg, lager and salt into a smooth batter.Heat the oil to 185°C.Dip the curds in batches and fry until puffed and golden.Drain on paper and serve straight away with ranch dressing.Mooby's golden friesDouble-fried russet fries with salt and paprika in paper conesHow to make it1kg russet potatoes2 L vegetable oil, for frying1 tsp salt1/2 tsp sweet paprikaCut the potatoes into thin fries, soak and dry well.Fry in the vegetable oil at 140°C and cool.Fry again at 190°C until golden.Toss with salt and paprika and serve in paper cones.Dining car turkey club bitesThe long train ride east toward New JerseyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Toasted triple-stack club sandwiches of roast turkey, crispy bacon, tomato, cos and herb mayo, cut into small triangles and pinned with toothpicks.Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp.Toast 12 slices of white bread.Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped chives and a little Dijon.For each club, spread 3 slices of toast with mayo, then layer 300g sliced roast turkey and cos on the first, bacon and sliced tomato on the second, and close with the third.Press down, pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into 4 triangles.Serve with crisps.MainsMooby's cow burgersSmashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles, onion, special sauceHow to make it600g beef mince1 tsp salt8 slices of American cheese4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp tomato sauce4 dill pickles1 onion, diced4 burger bunsRoll the mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and a chopped pickle for the sauce.Smash each ball flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook, then flip and top with cheese.Toast the buns. Stack 2 patties per bun with sauce, sliced pickles and diced onion.Bethany's chicken and leek pot pieBethany's quiet life in Illinois before the angels turn upHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken, leek, carrot and peas in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, baked until it bubbles up through the edges.Heat the oven to 200°C.Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 20g butter, remove.Cook 2 sliced leeks, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 6 minutes.Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick.Add the chicken, 150g frozen peas, thyme, salt and pepper.Spoon into a pie dish, top with 1 puff pastry sheet, cut a vent, brush with egg and bake 25 to 30 minutes.SweetsGolden calf caramel sliceShortbread base, golden caramel and milk chocolate topHow to make it125g butter, cold, for the base200g plain flour50g caster sugar60g butter, for the caramel395g sweetened condensed milk2 tbsp golden syrup200g milk chocolateRub the butter into the flour and sugar, press into a lined tin.Bake the base at 180°C.Simmer the condensed milk, butter and golden syrup until thick and golden, then pour over the base.Bake again.Cool, top with melted chocolate and cut into squares.DrinksMooby's vanilla shakeThick vanilla ice cream milkshake served in tall cupsHow to make it1 L vanilla ice cream500ml milk1 tsp vanilla extractBlend the ice cream, milk and vanilla until thick and smooth.Pour into 4 tall cups and serve with straws straight away.
